Subject: Billing discrepancy on Sept invoices – duplicate connector charge

Hi Soojin / Ben,

Quick note from AP: we were billed twice for the "Eastern Connector" line on invoice #NM-202609-117 (Sept). Line item appears on both subscription and an out-of-band usage file — same charge of EUR 12,300 net. Our AP team cannot apply the full payment until we receive a formal credit note for the duplicate charge, and we also need the VAT reversal to be explicit (we operate in Ireland — 23% VAT).

Can you:
- Confirm whether this is an overbilling (duplicate ingestion pipeline) or a one-off posting error
- Issue a credit note referencing the original invoice and showing net + VAT breakdown (we need a PDF for our vendor ledger)
- If possible, get the credit to us by EOD 2026-10-05 so we can close the month cleanly

Attaching the invoice PDF we received and a snippet of the usage manifest (apparent duplicate).

Thanks — Jordan

Team —

I dug into the ledger and the raw usage export (attached). Summary:
- Invoice NM-202609-117 includes a subscription charge for "Eastern Connector (monthly)" net EUR 12,300 and a separate usage line with an identical charge (same external_id) that appears to have been posted in error. Total duplicate net = EUR 12,300.
- VAT: Novamed is Ireland-based; VAT rate = 23%. VAT on the duplicated net = EUR 2,829.00.
- Suggested remediation: issue two documents: 1) Credit Note A — reversal of the duplicated service (net EUR 12,300, VAT EUR 2,829) to cancel the duplicate; 2) Goodwill Credit B — an internal courtesy credit (net EUR 0 / VAT 0) if Ben confirms we want to explicitly mark remediation as goodwill.

Proposal for immediate customer deliverable:
- Draft Credit Note (credit_note_draft.pdf) shows: reference to NM-202609-117, itemized net and VAT reversal, total credit EUR 15,129.00.
- If Ben signals this was an operational error on our side, I recommend including a one-line goodwill credit memo referencing support ticket #SUP-4821 for transparency. That would not change cash flow but helps audit trails.

Requested approvals:
- Ben: confirm whether to attach goodwill credit memo language
- Soojin: approve sending the draft PDF and have Tessa issue final credit note and email to ap@novamed.com

I'm attaching: usage_export_sept.csv (export), credit_note_draft.pdf (PDF stub).

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett

laura_bennett@redwood.com
